verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own pricing page lists "Attorney Review — Included", so licensed attorneys have some documented role in its petitions. However, no lawyers are named, no attorney-of-record or filing model is stated, and the visa pages describe only a generic "team" that works with you. missing for 10: named attorneys or bar credentials, an explicit attorney-of-record/filing model, evidence that attorneys prepare and file (not just review) petitions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service

citations.quote: Lighthouse handles the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire
